target_definition: resolution_outcome in explicit churned outcome categories

leakage_columns_excluded.resolution_outcome: post-interaction outcome used to derive the target
leakage_columns_excluded.churn_risk_level: source risk assessment label, not an input feature
leakage_columns_excluded.conversation: free text can contain post-outcome and target-identifying language
leakage_columns_excluded.summary: summary can contain target-identifying outcome language
leakage_columns_excluded.churn_signals: source signal annotation is target-adjacent and excluded
